steps.content: You've walked far and fought hard in search of your 'old friend.' Now, you can finally sense her presence more clearly—she's nearby.

But that mechanical behemoth is here too, at the center of the pollution storm. And in this spacetime, it obviously has all its power. It's marching forward slowly. You can see the twisted light around it, and its pollution pouring out. Just then, you hear the howl of Corruptors.
You can't retreat, nor do you want to. If the person you're looking for is here, then before she leaves, you must get through these monsters.
